授業方法:
Seminar. Based on readings, case studies, and class discussions,
students will gain a broad understanding of sustainability and business
practices in Japan. At the beginning of each class, students will discuss the
assigned readings and case studies. These discussions will be followed by
explanations from the instructor and supplemented by additional course
materials. Through field trips and fieldwork, students will deepen their
understanding of the course topics and experience sustainability challenges
first-hand.
